questions.question: What did David declare the threshing-floor site would become?
options: The house of the LORD God
A royal palace for the king
questions.answer: The house of the LORD God

questions.question: Why did God say David could not build the temple?
options: He had grown too old and weak for it
He had sinned by numbering the people
He had broken his vow to the LORD
He had shed much blood and waged wars
questions.answer: He had shed much blood and waged wars

questions.question: David made extensive preparations of materials before his death for the temple.
David's son who would build the temple was named _____.
David charged Solomon, 'Be strong and _____, and do it. Do not be afraid.'
